description: This Java class handles the creation of General Ledger accounts in the Fineract accounting module. It implements a command handler interface, uses annotations for transaction management and command typing, and delegates account creation to a service layer.

classes.name: CreateGLAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles 'CREATE' commands for General Ledger accounts, implementing the processCommand method to delegate to the write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the 'CREATE' command by invoking the createGLAccount method on the write platform service, encapsulating the account creation logic.
